name: COMBINE schema (addition; multiple agents)
description: MWP schema for combining quantities from multiple agents/sources into a total. Operation = addition. Pattern: agent_1 has X + agent_2 has Y -> total Z = X + Y. Brain analogue: prefrontal additive composition + ventral-stream entity-quantity binding.
instance_question_examples: John has 3 apples. Mary has 5 apples. How many apples in total?
There are 4 red balls and 6 blue balls. How many balls altogether?

name: CHANGE_ADD schema (transfer-in; agent receives)
description: MWP schema for state change where agent receives quantity. Operation = addition. Pattern: agent has X + receives Y -> agent now has X + Y. Brain analogue: cognitive map state-update + hippocampal episodic schema integration.
instance_question_examples: John has 5 apples. He picks up 3 more. How many apples now?
Mary had 7 stickers. She got 4 more. How many stickers now?

name: CHANGE_SUB schema (transfer-out; agent gives)
description: MWP schema for state change where agent gives away quantity. Operation = subtraction. Pattern: agent has X - gives Y -> agent now has X - Y. Brain analogue: cognitive map state-update + hippocampal episodic schema integration.
instance_question_examples: John has 8 apples. He gives 3 to Mary. How many apples now?
Mary had 10 stickers. She gave away 4. How many stickers left?

name: EQUAL_GROUPS schema (multiplication; equal-sized sets)
description: MWP schema for total of equal-sized groups. Operation = multiplication. Pattern: N groups of Y items each -> total N*Y. Brain analogue: prefrontal multiplicative composition + ventral-stream repeated-set binding.
instance_question_examples: There are 5 boxes with 3 apples each. How many apples total?
John has 4 bags of 6 marbles. How many marbles in all?

name: COMPARE schema (compare-larger or compare-smaller)
description: MWP schema for comparing two quantities. Operation = subtraction (difference) or division (ratio). Pattern: agent_1 has X + agent_2 has Y -> difference |X-Y| or ratio X/Y. Brain analogue: parietal numerical-comparison + ANS magnitude estimation.
instance_question_examples: John has 8 apples. Mary has 5 apples. How many more apples does John have?
There are 12 boys and 7 girls. How many more boys than girls?

name: SHARE schema (division; equal distribution)
description: MWP schema for equal distribution. Operation = division. Pattern: total quantity X / N agents -> qty_per_agent X/N. Brain analogue: prefrontal proportional reasoning + ventral-stream distributive binding.
instance_question_examples: There are 15 apples shared equally among 3 people. How many apples each?
John has 24 marbles and distributes them equally to 4 friends. How many marbles each?

name: ARG0 agent role (donor / actor / owner)
description: Semantic role ARG0 = agent who performs action or owns initial state. PropBank ARG0. Brain analogue: ventral-stream entity recognition + prefrontal agent-attribution.

name: ARG1 theme role (object / quantity-binding)
description: Semantic role ARG1 = theme/patient that undergoes the action; usually the object + quantity. PropBank ARG1. Brain analogue: ventral-stream object-recognition + parietal quantity-binding.

name: ARG2 recipient role (receiver / target)
description: Semantic role ARG2 = recipient or target of transfer. PropBank ARG2. Brain analogue: cognitive map destination-binding + episodic recipient-tracking.

name: ARGM-LOC location modifier
description: Semantic role ARGM-LOC = location modifier (in box, at store, etc.). PropBank ARGM-LOC. Brain analogue: hippocampal place-binding + entorhinal grid-cell spatial coding.

name: ARGM-TMP temporal modifier
description: Semantic role ARGM-TMP = temporal modifier (yesterday, before, after). PropBank ARGM-TMP. Brain analogue: hippocampal temporal-context binding + cerebellar temporal sequence.
